title: Grateful Dead Live at Crisler Arena - University of Michigan on 1989-04-05
lineage: Master Cassettes (Maxell MX90 Metal) Tascam 112 -> Korg MR-1, @ 1bit 2.8MHz -> USB -> Korg Audio Gate Software 24bit 48KHz -> Wave Lab 5.0 w/UAD ->  r8brain PRO for Sample Rate Conversion 16/44.1KHz -> Traders Little Helper flac8
source: Nakamichi CM-100 mics with CP-4 shotgun caps -> Sony D-5

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear audience tape with excellent instrument separation captures a superb Grateful Dead performance.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the Holtz audience recording, calling it clear, crisp and exceptionally well‑separated with minimal crowd chatter. The show itself is described as great, making this release a top‑tier listening experience despite the lack of detailed song commentary.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise both the audio fidelity and the performance, indicating an excellent show captured on a high‑quality audience tape, but the small sample size limits confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and crisp sound with superb instrument/voice separation; good audience presence without distracting chatter; no noticeable muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers note a great overall show but provide no specific details on set structure or individual songs.
